title: Goal and university
sub: Choosing your level, field and city
intro: The first step: you decide which level, which field and which university to apply to. This decision shapes all the documents that follow.

blocks.title: What to do
items: Choose your level: Foundation, bachelor's or master's. With an 11-year school certificate you usually need a Foundation year or 1 year at university.
Find English-taught programmes in the university list: each university page has a link.
Compare the requirements: years of schooling, B2 certificate, test (CEnT-S, TOLC, SAT, IMAT), GPA.
Choose the city with the scholarship in mind too: the DSU amount and conditions differ in each region.
Pick 3–5 universities and put their application dates in your calendar.

blocks.title: Get ready
items: International passport
English certificate (usually B2)
School certificate or diploma with grades
List of universities and dates

blocks.text: Apply to 3–5 universities, not just one: their dates differ, so if you miss one, you still have others.

when: Usually November – April (different at each university)
intro: Pre-acceptance is the university's answer «we are ready to admit you». Each university has its own application portal and deadline (DreamApply, MoveIn, Apply@... and others). You upload your documents, the committee reviews them, and if you pass, you receive a pre-acceptance letter. The next stages start with this letter.

blocks.label: Universities: the application link for each
blocks.note: 82 universities, with application pages and deadlines

items.small: English or Italian, depending on the programme language

blocks.title: Steps
items: On the university page read the «Programmes» and «Admission and requirements» sections: deadline, fee, requirements.
Register on the application portal (the link is on the «Application page» button on the university page). Use the same email everywhere.
Complete your profile and upload documents as clear colour PDFs.
Pay the application fee: unpaid applications are not reviewed.
Wait for the result. When pre-acceptance arrives, move straight to DoV/CIMEA. If the university does not do the pre-enrollment for you, submit it yourself on Universitaly.

blocks.title: Documents
items: Passport
School certificate or diploma
Certificate from your school or university (if you are studying now: where, and in which grade or year)
Transcript (record of grades)
Language certificate (usually B2)
If the programme asks: CV, motivation letter, SAT / CEnT-S / TOLC / GMAT result
Optional: recommendation letter

blocks.title: What the requirements are
blocks.body:
A bachelor's degree usually requires 12 years of schooling. With an 11-year certificate you can do a Foundation year, or study for 1 year at a university in Uzbekistan and then apply.

A master's requires a bachelor's degree and subjects matching the chosen programme. Many programmes have a minimum GPA.

Some bachelor's programmes ask for a SAT or CEnT-S result; master's programmes sometimes include an interview or a video interview (for example Macerata).

blocks.title: Common mistakes
items: Waiting for the last day: the portal slows down and places may run out.
Blurry or incomplete scans: scan every page clearly and in colour.
Applying to only one university: deadlines differ, apply to 3–5.
Using different emails: all letters should go to one address.

blocks.text: Example: at Sapienza (Rome) the MoveIn portal allows up to 2 applications a year, 30 € each. Politecnico di Milano master's for 2027/28: until 28.01.2027. Each university's exact date is on its page.
Apply early: from 2026/27 universities can confirm at most 20% more pre-enrollments on Universitaly than their quota. When places run out, latecomers are left out.

blocks.label: Motivation letter builder
blocks.note: 8 questions: your draft letter is ready

title: DoV or CIMEA
sub: Getting your diploma recognised in Italy
when: Immediately after pre-acceptance: needed for the visa
intro: Italy needs to know what your diploma is equivalent to. There are two ways: the Dichiarazione di Valore (DoV) issued by the embassy, or CIMEA's online certificate. Your university will tell you which one it needs.

items.text: Issued by the consular section of the Italian Embassy in Tashkent. Documents must be apostilled and translated into Italian.
Online, via the DiploMe platform. Statement of Comparability (what the diploma is equivalent to) and Statement of Verification (authenticity of the diploma).

blocks.title: DoV: steps
items: Get an apostille on your school certificate or diploma, transcript and certificate from your school or university.
Have them translated into Italian by one of the embassy's trusted translators. If the translation is wrong, you have to apply again from the start.
Download the application form from the embassy website and fill it in.
Download the pre-enrollment form from Universitaly.
Go to the consular section: Wednesday 9:30–12:30 (surnames A–L), Friday 9:30–12:30 (M–Z). Another person can submit with a power of attorney.

blocks.title: DoV and CIMEA: documents
items: Passport copy
School certificate or diploma
Transcript (record of grades)
Certificate from your school or university
Language certificate
Apostille and Italian translation: school certificate or diploma, transcript and certificate (original and colour copy with apostille)
For DoV: completed application form
For DoV: Universitaly pre-enrollment form

items.small: fast track: Comparability in 30 working days

blocks.title: CIMEA: steps
items: Register yourself on cimea-diplome.it. CIMEA does not accept applications through intermediaries.
In the Service Finder choose your country and diploma: the system shows the service type and price (150 € or 300 €).
Upload the documents and pay. The fast-track service can only be chosen when applying.
Upload the finished certificate to your university and to Universitaly.

blocks.text: CIMEA Comparability replaces the DoV only if the university accepts it on Universitaly. The authenticity of the diploma is confirmed separately.
CIMEA takes 60 working days, about 3 months. Start as soon as pre-acceptance arrives so you do not miss the visa deadline.

blocks.label: Embassy: DoV page
blocks.note: Application form and list of translators

when: By the university's deadline (usually spring – summer)
intro: Universitaly is the Italian ministry's single portal. Here you submit the pre-enrollment application for your chosen programme. The university confirms it and the application goes to the embassy. Without a confirmed pre-enrollment you cannot apply for the visa.

blocks.text: The university sets the deadline itself (in 2026/27 it was between 30.06 and 15.09). A university cannot confirm more applications than its quota +20%: if you are late, there may be no places left.

At some universities pre-acceptance and pre-enrollment happen in one step: once the university reviews and accepts your application, it also confirms the pre-enrollment on Universitaly or includes it in the admission process. Then you do not need to do anything separately. Check how your university works on its admission page or by email. Either way, to apply for the visa you must have a confirmed pre-enrollment in your name on Universitaly: check it in your Universitaly account.

blocks.title: What to do
items: Register on universitaly.it.
Fill in the pre-enrollment form: personal details, programme, scans of passport and diploma.
The university confirms it and sends the application to the embassy.
You receive an email about applying for the visa. Then go to stage 4.

blocks.title: Documents
items: Passport scan
School certificate or diploma scan
Pre-acceptance letter

blocks.title: What the confirmation means
blocks.body:
The university reviews your application and confirms it (validation). For the visa this confirmation must be unconditional: documents complete and admission final.

The PDF summary of the confirmed pre-enrollment is on the list of visa documents. Download and print it.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
items: Using different emails on the university portal and on Universitaly.
Choosing the wrong programme name: it must match the name in the pre-acceptance letter.
Booking a visa appointment without waiting for the university's confirmation.

blocks.text: Use the same email on the university portal and on Universitaly. The embassy's letter comes to exactly that address.
Help: universitaly@cineca.it (technical) · info@uni-italia.it

title: Visa
when: From 6 months to 15 days before travel; 2026/27: by 30.11.2026, 2027/28: by 31.10.2027
intro: Submitted to the consular section of the Italian Embassy in Tashkent. It is a type D national visa: 91 to 365 days, multiple entry. Processing takes up to 90 days, and your passport stays at the embassy during that time.

items.small: proof of funds per year (2026/27 and 2027/28)

blocks.title: Steps
items: Wait for your Universitaly pre-enrollment to be confirmed.
Collect the documents according to the list. Translations are done by the embassy's trusted translators.
An apostille is enough for Uzbek documents: Uzbekistan is a party to the Hague Convention.
Get the bank statement last of all: it must not be older than 10 working days.
Submit to the consular section: not earlier than 6 months and not later than 15 days before travel.
Wait for the answer. Your passport is not returned until a decision is made.

blocks.text: Proof of funds: {{viza}} per year. The money must come from a legal, traceable source: your own account or your family's (relatives up to the 4th degree). The embassy checks the account activity and whether the amount matches the family's income. Having applied for, or being eligible for, a scholarship does not count instead of money.

Deadlines: 30.11.2026 for 2026/27, 31.10.2027 for 2027/28 (bachelor's and master's). A university may set an earlier deadline: check your university's page. There is no fixed deadline for Foundation courses, but do not apply later than the start of classes.

blocks.title: Documents (embassy list)
items: Signed visa application form (original)
1 photo, white background, not older than 6 months
Passport: issued within the last 10 years, valid for 90 more days after the visa expires, 2 blank pages
Copy of passport and ID
Certificate of residence (my.gov.uz)
Copy of the Universitaly pre-enrollment
University admission letter in Italian: type of course, duration, how classes are held
Receipt of at least the first payment
Language certificate
Diploma and transcript: original and copy
Italian translation of the diploma and transcript
DoV and/or CIMEA Comparability (original and copy)
Letter of no objection from the employer or the sponsoring family member
Bank statement for the last 3 months (Uzbek bank, on bank letterhead, with a wet stamp)
International card statement, last 3 months
Certificate of employment and salary from my.gov.uz (yours or the sponsor's)
Insurance: at least 30 000 €, whole Schengen area and the whole period
Accommodation for the first month: booking or an invitation from a person in Italy
Return ticket booking
Signed checklist (in Italian and in a language you understand)

blocks.title: Common mistakes
items: Bank statement out of date or without a stamp.
Insurance covers only Italy, not the whole Schengen area.
Translation done by a translator who is not on the list.
Applying late: the 90-day processing does not finish before classes start.

blocks.text: You cannot enrol at a university on a tourist visa. Only a type D student visa.
Before anything else, check your passport validity: it must be valid for 90 more days after the visa expires.

title: Scholarship (DSU)
when: Application usually June – September (depending on the region)
intro: In Italy the scholarship is given by the agency of the region where the university is located (DiSCo in Lazio, DSU Toscana in Tuscany, and so on). It is based on family income. The application is submitted in summer while you are still in Uzbekistan, so you prepare the family documents before leaving. Below it is explained using Lazio (Sapienza, Tor Vergata, Roma Tre) as an example.

blocks.text: Each region's agency, deadline and link are on the «Scholarships» page. In 2026/27 the state minimum: {{stip}} for a fuori sede student, ISEE limit {{isee}}.

items.small: per year in cash, fuori sede (Lazio, 2026/27); with meals in total ~7 171 – 8 157 €
free meals a day (worth 600 € a year)

blocks.title: What to do
items: In 2026/27 the online application on laziodisco.it ran from 10.06 to 22.07.2026, 12:00, and errors were corrected 30.07 – 11.08. The 2027/28 dates are usually announced in spring.
Get your family documents in Uzbekistan, have them legalised at the Italian Embassy (or apostilled; ask the agency or a CAF in advance which one is accepted) and translated into Italian.
In Italy, get your ISEEUP parificato at a CAF recognised by DiSCo: by 10.12.2026.
Upload your permesso documents to the «Il mio profilo» section: by 10.12.2026.
Enter your IBAN. The money is paid into this account.

blocks.title: Documents
items: Family composition and residence: name, date of birth and address of each member
Income of each member for 2024. If someone does not work, a document stating this clearly
Housing: whether family members own property and its size (cadastre certificate)
Bank: savings of each member as of 31.12.2024 (if none, a document stating so)
Rental contract, only if the family rents

blocks.text: If your family lives abroad, you count as «fuori sede» even without a rental contract, which means you get the largest amount. In Rome the free meals can be exchanged for money when applying.
Not accepted: an application written by yourself, an affidavit or a sworn statement. The family's total income cannot be zero.

blocks.label: Family documents list (Word)
blocks.note: To give to the translator and tick off

title: After arrival in Italy
sub: First-week tasks, in the right order
when: Housing: before arrival. Permesso: within 8 working days of arrival
intro: The visa lets you enter Italy, but the right to live there comes from the permesso di soggiorno. Below everything is in the order it is done: housing first, then the first days' tasks, and full enrollment at the very end.

blocks.text: Before arrival: find housing. This is students' biggest problem: good rooms are booked long before classes start. Search through the university's housing office, Uzbek students in that city and reliable websites. Do not transfer money without seeing the place on video and signing a contract. At least for the first weeks, have a place (dormitory or hostel) booked.

blocks.title: After arrival: in this order
items: Get a SIM card: at a TIM, Vodafone, WindTre or Iliad shop, with your passport. An Italian number is needed for the permesso, the bank and the university.
Get a public transport card: a monthly or yearly pass from the city transport company. Many cities have student discounts.
Buy a 16 € marca da bollo (revenue stamp) at a Tabaccheria (tobacco shop).

At a Poste Italiane office marked «Sportello Amico», get the yellow kit for your first permesso. Fill in and sign Form 1, and add copies of your passport and visa, insurance and financial documents, and the marca da bollo.
Hand in the kit at the post office and get the receipt (ricevuta): until the card arrives, it is your document. Do this within 8 working days of arrival.

Get your codice fiscale (tax code): at an Agenzia delle Entrate office, with passport and visa, free of charge. It is needed for the bank, the rental contract and the scholarship. If it was issued earlier, you do not need a new one.
Open a bank account (IBAN): the DSU scholarship is paid into it. You need a codice fiscale for this.
The Questura will call you for fingerprints: the date and time are on the receipt or in an SMS. The card is usually ready about 90 days after that.

Once you have the permesso receipt: full enrollment (step 8). It requires your passport, visa, permesso receipt and diploma documents (DoV or CIMEA); a codice fiscale is not required. Do not miss the deadline set by the university.

blocks.text: Optional but very useful: the tessera sanitaria (Italian health card). If you register with the Italian national health service (SSN), you choose a family doctor (medico di base) and use public clinics and hospitals like Italians do. Voluntary registration for students costs {{ssn}} per year (per calendar year). Go to the local ASL office with your permesso receipt and codice fiscale.

blocks.title: First week: checklist
items: Flat or room (before arrival)
Italian SIM card
Public transport card
Permesso receipt (ricevuta)
Bank account (IBAN)
Health insurance for the whole period
Optional: tessera sanitaria

blocks.text: Do not lose the post office receipt. Until the card arrives it is your document, and it is asked for at full enrollment and at the scholarship agency. On Sapienza's main campus (CU007) there is a police office for permesso matters.
Note: applying for a dormitory does not count as proof of accommodation for the visa. More on finding housing, avoiding scams and rental contracts: «Living in Italy» page.

when: After arriving in Italy, by the deadline set by the university
intro: The last step: you hand in your original documents to the university's international students (or foreign degrees) office and complete full registration. Many universities require this within a month of arrival (for example Ferrara).

blocks.title: Documents
items: Valid passport
«University enrolment» student visa
Permesso application receipt
School certificate or diploma, with an official translation into Italian or English
CIMEA Comparability and Verification, or DoV and apostilled documents

blocks.text: At registration you make the first payment, and the amount depends on the university. It usually includes the regional scholarship tax (tassa regionale per il diritto allo studio, 140 € in many regions) and a 16 € bollo; at some universities a university contribution is added too. At many universities the 1st instalment of the university contribution, based on ISEE, is also added. Example, Sapienza: at least 156 € (140 € + 16 €); if you pay later instalments late, the fine is 65 € (130 € if more than 60 days), and in the 1st year you cannot register at all after the deadline. Siena: if late, +15 € up to 7 days, +60 € from the 8th day. Check the exact amount and deadline on your university's «Tasse e contributi» page.
The scholarship agency also waits for your enrollment and permesso documents (for example Lazio DiSCo in 2026/27 until 10.12.2026). Check your regional agency's deadline on the «Scholarships» page.
Example, Sapienza: HELLO – Foreign Students office, Piazzale Aldo Moro 5, Servizi Generali building, staircase C, 2nd floor · Hello@uniroma1.it · +39 06 49690261
